events.verdict: Gafford (DAL) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Harden (LAC) is bracing for the contact from Flagg (DAL) as they come together at the end of the drive, and the contact that occurs as Harden releases away is marginal.

Flagg (DAL) legally contests Harden's (LAC) jump shot attempt. Harden is already going to the ground on his own accord prior to any marginal leg contact with Flagg as Flagg jumps to the side of Harden after his contest.
Harden's (LAC) shot attempt does not touch the basket ring and the 24 second shot clock expires while the ball is in the air. This is a violation and the Mavericks are correctly awarded possession.
Zubac (LAC) legally contests Russell's (DAL) layup attempt.
Bogdanovic (LAC) brings his hand toward the ball on his dislodge attempt and marginal follow-through contact occurs with Russell's (DAL) leg during the driving shot attempt.
Gafford (DAL) legally contests Zubac's (LAC) shot attempt.
Christie (DAL) and Jones Jr.'s (LAC) engage and immediately disengage as marginal contact occurs during the pick.
Harden (LAC) moves alongside Russell's (DAL) path and maintains a legal guarding position as incidental contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.

Prior to the timeout, Russell (DAL) is established in Harden's (LAC) path and absorbs the marginal contact initiated by Harden as they come together at midcourt. Harden is legally allowed to regain control of the loose ball and never ended his dribble previously.
Marshall (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position and incidental contact occurs as he defends Harden (LAC) during the drive.
Russell (DAL) legally contests Dunn's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Zubac (LAC) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge it from Marshall (DAL) as he pursues the rebound.
Dunn (LAC) momentarily rests his arm on Flagg's (DAL) body and immediately slides it off when he engages on the pick.
Russell (DAL) places his hand on Bogdanovic's (LAC) front and the contact is marginal during the drive.
Bogdanovic (LAC) turns to align himself alongside Russell's (DAL) path and marginal contact occurs during the driving shot attempt.
Zubac (LAC) and Gafford (DAL) make clean contact with the ball and marginal contact occurs during the pursuit of the rebound.
Harden (LAC) and Flagg (DAL) come together at the same spot on the perimeter, and the body to body contact that occurs is marginal.
Harden (LAC) contests the layup attempt and marginal contact occurs with Flagg's (DAL) arm after the release.
Marshall (DAL) legally contests Harden's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Harden (LAC) is moving slightly laterally while retreating when he absorbs the marginal contact from Flagg (DAL) as they converge during the drive.
Zubac (LAC) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he moves to imminently guard an opponent.
Bogdanovic (LAC) reaches in and initiates contact with Russell's (DAL) wrist after his two-handed gather, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Flagg (DAL) legally contests Jones Jr.'s (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Harden (LAC) releases away from Marshall (DAL) and the contact is marginal before Harden secures the long rebound.
Marshall (DAL) legally contests Harden's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Zubac (LAC) and Gafford (DAL) mutually engage and marginal contact occurs as they jostle for rebounding position.
Bogdanovic (LAC) initiates illegal contact with Marshall's (DAL) body, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Marshall (DAL) directly contests Harden's (LAC) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Harden's hand after the release.
Flagg (DAL) is bracing for the contact with Batum (LAC) as they come together at the end of the drive, and the contact that occurs as Flagg releases away is marginal.
Batum (LAC) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Flagg's (DAL) layup attempt.
Marshall (DAL) commits a take foul on Harden (LAC).
Marshall (DAL) places his arm in Harden's (LAC) path, and as he retracts it, marginal contact occurs with Harden's arm while Harden gathers during the driving shot attempt.

After a goaltending violation is whistled, the crew consults the Replay Center to review the call on the floor. The Replay Center overturns the ruling to a clean block, and under the imminent possession rule, Dallas is awarded the ball.
Christie (DAL) loses control of the ball on his own accord and there is no contact from Bogdanovic (LAC).
